text:
elena: Quick sync — PRD draft for "model fallback policy" is up. Need scope call: per-route fallback vs global. Short answers welcome.
ryan: link to doc? can you paste the acceptance bullets?
elena: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PRD-407
elena: Acceptance criteria:
```
- API supports `fallback_model` per route config
- If primary model OOM/timeout -> automatically route to fallback within 200ms
- Logs include model chosen + latency + token cost
- Rollout can be canaryed by customer id
- No change to existing client contracts unless opt-in
```
sam: For runtime: do we allow fallback to smaller quantized variant of same model? that keeps format parity.
ryan: yes, that's the plan. runtime will accept compatible model families. need kernel mapping table.
tess_qa: Edge cases: prompt compatibility, embeddings mismatch, and prompt-length limits. I'll add tests:
- prompt that needs > KV cache -> verify fallback doesn't re-run previous tokens
- embeddings: ensure dimension invariants if we fallback for embed endpoint
alexd: UX: console needs clear flag + per-route UI + audit trail. Also per-customer override.
elena: Scope decision: MVP supports chat/completions + embeddings fallback to same-family, rerank falls back to scoring model only (no re-ranking). Rollout: gradual 10/25/50/100 by customer pool.
ryan: perf SLA concern: fallback must be under 2x latency of primary. We'll add metric: p95_primary_vs_fallback_ratio
sam: ops: how to handle billing? We should bill at the model actually executed. also show estimated cost delta in console.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: infra-migrations/2026-03-15 09:00 UTC -> canary
elena: Final ask: ok to cut scope to "compatible-family only" and postpone cross-family adapters to next quarter? quick + :thumbsup: or concerns.
ryan: +1
sam: +1
tess_qa: +1, will author test matrix
alexd: +1, will prep UI mockups
elena: Great — I'll merge PRD and start RFC for runtime mapping table. Thanks all.
